{{Top|leg}}
'''Chudde and orxtle sandwiches''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] using the ingredients [[chudde]] and [[orxtle]]. While the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] duo [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], a male Wookiee, were interviewed by the [[Director of Research]] for the [[Inner Council (New Republic)|New Republic Inner Council]], [[Voren Na'al]], Chewbacca took a moment to retrieve one such [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] from the kitchen.<ref name="HSSource">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
